text: Acceptance amendment: define the semantic-context contract. Every activity subject can optionally reference an immutable semantic snapshot by campaign/run identity, campaign/workspace commit, and contract digest. The contract distinguishes `at_event` from `current` meaning and states `attached`, `unavailable`, or `stale` availability. Tests cover a unit renamed or reconfigured after an old event, plus array-task and packed-member resolution, without changing historical presentation.
